title: Claim the Crow-Crowned Boss Mound: Gate Verdict
description: Claim the Crow-Crowned Boss Mound: Gate Verdict is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth through The Silver-Root Gate (Sealed Gate with fae time bleed). Your avatar of one selected deity from Dagda, Morrígan, Brigid, Lugh enters; this beat spotlights Lugh as the reference silhouette while preserving Avatar choice. The mission is the boss step at Crow-Crowned Boss Mound, using living mound-gate maze and geas trial pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: Avalora is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use silver branch crowns, moonlit green-gold, living bark armor, woven thorn mantles, mist veils, standing stone geometry, battle-crow omens, cauldron glow, druid knots as organic growth not decoration, geas scars, fae glass, root-lace anatomy..
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Crow-Crowned Boss Mound and reveals: How fae time pools bend cooldowns and memory. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Crow-Crowned Boss Mound configured as a boss space inside living mound-gate maze and geas trial; source-culture appearance layer: sídhe mound gates, moon-grove rootlabyrinths, silver-root lanes, standing stone courts, cauldron-lit springs, thorn covenant walls; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: Lugh silver-spear thornblades, moon-oak sídhe mantles, Dagda cauldron memory cores, fae glamour reversals

objectives.primary: With one selected deity, defeat the boss encounter against The Crow-Crowned Geas Fracture inside the Crow-Crowned Boss Mound and complete the Ascension route without breaking canon.
optional: Clear the Crow-Crowned Boss Mound before the route pressure reaches its final warning
Exploit or avoid the route rule: cauldron wells that heal whoever pays the right memory
Resolve at least two geas obedience, fae time reads, crow omen priority, silver-root route memory decisions before victory
